content: Super easy to use. I figured out how to record and share my first run in under a minute.
The app crashes every time I try to upload a long ride. Lost two hours of data this week.
Why is the settings menu buried three levels deep? I can never find where to change privacy zones.
Love the segments feature but the subscription price went up again, getting expensive.
GPS drifts a lot in the city and the battery drains fast during long runs.
The lessons are short and intuitive, my kids learned the app without any help.
Way too many ads after every single lesson. It's unbearable unless you pay.
I keep tapping the wrong button because the check and skip buttons are right next to each other.
Great app. Would love an offline mode for when I travel.
Support never answered my emails about the refund. Terrible customer service.
After the redesign I can't find the practice section anymore. Had to relearn everything.
Calm, beautiful design and everything is exactly where you expect it to be.
The app takes forever to load and sometimes freezes on the home screen.
They shared my data with advertisers? Uninstalling. Privacy should matter for a mental health app.
Good content but I wish I could download sessions to listen offline.
Every time I open it I forget how to get back to my saved meditations. Confusing navigation.
Logging food takes way too many taps. Scanning a barcode should be one step, not five.
Barcode scanner is now premium only. Paywall everything, no thanks.
Fast, reliable and the food database is huge. Best tracker I've used.
Error messages just say 'something went wrong' with no way to fix it. I lost my whole diary entry.
Once you learn the shortcuts, logging meals becomes really quick.
The app logged me out and I had to reset my password twice this month.
Good
I've been using it every day for a year, it is genuinely fun and keeps me motivated.
Charged my card after I cancelled the free trial and support ignored me.
Text is tiny and the colors have poor contrast, hard to read while running.
Undo button saved me so many times when I logged the wrong meal.
The new update moved all the buttons. Took me a week to get used to it again.
Simple, clean, and I never get lost. Exactly what a meditation app should be.
Constant notifications pushing me to upgrade. Feels manipulative.
